title: Xuefu Zhuyu Decoction improves hyperlipidemia through the MAPK/NF-kappaB and MAPK/PPARalpha/CPT-1A signaling pathway.
authors: Han, Jiajun; Miao, Yuyang; Song, Linze; Zhou, Xianfeng; Liu, Yan; Wang, Lin; Zhu, Kai; Ma, He; Ma, Yan; Li, Qingjie; Han, Dong
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药方剂改善高脂血症的机制，涉及MAPK/NF-kB等信号通路，分子对接仅用于药物成分与靶蛋白亲和力验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法聚焦TF-DNA结合。
abstract: Xuefu Zhuyu Decoction (XZD) is widely used in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases. The purpose of this study was to explore the pharmacological effects and molecular mechanisms of XZD in improving hyperlipidemia and to provide a theoretical framework for clinical application. In this study, the signaling pathways regulated by XZD in improving hyperlipidemia were predicted by network pharmacology. Molecular docking was used to verify the affinity between the components in XZD and the target. Furthermore, a hyperlipidemic model in rats was constructed through feeding a high-fat diet. The effect of XZD on hyperlipidemia was verified by histopathological staining, Elisa, and western blot. The results found that the XZD improved dyslipidemia and inflammatory factor disorders, and inhibited liver function damage, pathological damage, and oxidative stress damage in hyperlipidemic rats. The findings from molecular docking and network pharmacology suggested that the mechanism of XZD improving hyperlipidemia may be closely related to the MAPK, NF-kappaB, and PPAR pathways. This study demonstrated that the XZD inhibited liver lipid metabolism disorder and inflammatory response by regulating the MAPK/NF-kappaB and MAPK/PPARalpha/CPT-1A pathway, significantly improved liver histopathological damage and oxidative stress injury, and played a protective role in hyperlipidemic rats.
abstract_zh: 血府逐瘀汤（XZD）广泛用于心血管疾病的治疗。本研究旨在探讨XZD改善高脂血症的药理作用及分子机制，并为临床应用提供理论框架。本研究通过网络药理学预测XZD改善高脂血症所调控的信号通路，采用分子对接验证XZD中成分与靶点之间的亲和力。此外，通过高脂饮食喂养构建大鼠高脂血症模型，并通过组织病理学染色、Elisa和Western blot验证XZD对高脂血症的作用。结果发现，XZD改善了高脂血症大鼠的脂质代谢紊乱和炎症因子失调，并抑制了肝功能损伤、病理损伤及氧化应激损伤。分子对接和网络药理学的研究结果表明，XZD改善高脂血症的机制可能与MAPK、NF-kappaB和PPAR通路密切相关。本研究证明，XZD通过调控MAPK/NF-kappaB和MAPK/PPARalpha/CPT-1A通路，抑制肝脏脂质代谢紊乱和炎症反应，显著改善肝脏组织病理损伤和氧化应激损伤，并在高脂血症大鼠中发挥保护作用。
